full_claim_data.accident_description: On August 5, 2022, at approximately 20:14 (8:14 PM), a motor vehicle collision occurred when another vehicle crossed the centerline and struck the patient's vehicle on the driver's side [26][27][28]. The patient, who was driving and restrained at the time, experienced a T-bone impact that did not trigger airbag deployment and did not result in loss of consciousness [26][28]. Following the collision, the patient suffered left shoulder pain and restricted movement, and was subsequently transported
